sections.heading: A Professional Scheduling Component
sections.body_html: Bryntum Scheduler Pro is a JavaScript UI component that helps you plan with precision by accounting for resource availability, dependencies, and constraints.
sections.body_text: Bryntum Scheduler Pro is a JavaScript UI component that helps you plan with precision by accounting for resource availability, dependencies, and constraints.

sections.heading: Your JavaScript toolkit just got bigger
sections.body_html:
Following our 2025 partnership with Bryntum, the components you trust for data now sit alongside the best tools for scheduling and project planning.

You already trust AG Grid for your data, Bryntum Scheduler Pro brings the same standard to dependency-aware scheduling and resource planning — built by the same kind of team, to the same standard.

sections.heading: Connect Your Tasks
sections.body_html:
Once your tasks and dependencies are in place, the professional scheduling engine takes care of the rest by:

  • Organizing tasks based on how they relate to each other and the rules you’ve defined.
  • Automatically updating dependent tasks when you move a leading task.

sections.heading: Avoid Over-Allocating Your Resources
sections.body_html:
Manage your team’s workload with a built-in histogram and make faster and fairer decisions.

  • Bright red highlights let yout instantly spot over-capcity workloads without digging through tables or reports.
  • Adjust task assignments for balanced planning.

sections.heading: Use Skill-Based Task Assignments
sections.body_html:
Let Scheduler Pro handle the logic behind the scenes for efficient planning:

  • Easily assign the right tasks to the right people.
  • Match tasks with team members based on skills and availability.
  • Automatically schedule tasks or drag and drop them into suggested time slots.

sections.heading: Enjoy Intelligent, Adaptive Planning
sections.body_html:
Schedule with confidence for the real world:

  • Identify peak activity periods and overloaded categories using the heatmap.
  • Use nested events to simplify handling related tasks.
  • Account for travel time to plan callouts and field routing more efficiently.
  • Resolve scheduling conflicts and maintain the integrity of the schedule.

sections.heading: Customize Task Editing
sections.body_html:
Bryntum Scheduler Pro also comes with a powerful, customizable task editor:

  • Modify any base fields and add your own.
  • Edit predecessors, successors, and constraints.
  • Hide and show any preconfigured fields.
  • Create and edit multiple calendars.
  • Apply changes live, but roll them back if needed.

sections.heading: Style It Your Way
sections.body_html:
Make the scheduler match your brand with flexible styling options.

  • Easily modify our built-in themes using CSS variables.
  • Create your own custom theme.
  • Choose from preconfigured taskbar styles and color sets.

sections.heading: 50+ More Widgets
sections.body_html:
Choose from a wide range of UI elements that easily make your app polished and professional:

  • Add buttons, menus, toggles, charts, and more to the Bryntum Scheduler Pro.
  • Meet user needs with fewer clicks and less searching.
  • Implement widgets easily with our clear documentation.
